text:
carmen: Heads up — we're seeing a cluster of Xid 13s on a10 nodes in us-west2 around midnight. Spike coincides with tenant-42 burst. Ops bot logged ~48 Xid13s in 2h :warning:
terry: rough count? which hosts, and is it all on same PCIe root?
carmen: filtering now, quick sample: `nvmlEvents: Xid 13, GPU 3 (a10-01), trailer: ECC=0, PCIe=uncertain, ctx=0x4a`
carmen: host list from last 2h: i-azw3[a10-01], i-azw3[a10-03], i-azw3[a10-05] — all same rack, same switch.
puneet: can you pull per-tenant qps and avg seq len for tenant-42 during that window? hypothesis: many tiny requests causing hot KV thrash + decode pressure.
carmen: quick query: `SELECT tenant, sum(qps) as q FROM requests WHERE tenant='tenant-42' and ts>='2026-03-17T23:00Z' GROUP BY tenant` -> q=720 QPS peak, p95 seq_len=32, mean batch_size=1.
ops-bot: [automated] alert: xid13_count=48 (2h), affected_gpus=3, suggested_action=soft-drain-first, fallback_to-embedder-variant-ok
louis: small-batch = the usual killer for Xid13 on a10; could be per-request mem alloc churn causing driver assert. Reproduce with synthetic small-batch traffic on suspect hosts.
sophie: before full repro, can we try soft-drain + reroute for tenant-42 to see if errors fall? cheaper than swapping cards. set soft-drain weight to 0.5 for those 3 hosts and monitor for 30m.
terry: agree. also capture dmesg+kernel logs when repro'ing. ask infra to enable persistent logging for 1h on those hosts. command I used previously: `sudo journalctl -k -f --since "23:00" | grep -i nv`
puneet: if soft-drain reduces failures, we know it's workload sensitivity. then adjust batching/caching for tenant-42: batch to 8 or enable kv-cache prefixing for embedding use-case. That saves tokens and reduces decode pressure.
carmen: implementing soft-drain now: `orchctl set-drain i-azw3[a10-01] i-azw3[a10-03] i-azw3[a10-05] --soft --weight=0.5`
ops-bot: [automated] action: drain command accepted, will re-route new sessions in ~2m.
louis: if drain doesn't help, next step is PCIe root/motherboard swap during maintenance window. replacing cards has cost + lead time (RMA ~2w). consider targeted swap only if post-drain Xid rate > 10/hr.
sophie: add a short-term mitigations checklist: 1) soft-drain + reroute 2) enable kv cache for tenant 3) increase batch target to 8 4) capture perf counters (SM util, mem bw) for 30m. I'll create a follow-up incident with checklist.
carmen: noted. rolling update now. will report back at +30m with repro status and metric deltas. :white_check_mark:
